business_summary.text: Arkade Developers is a Mumbai-focused real estate company engaged in residential and commercial development, with a strong emphasis on redevelopment projects.

call_points.text: Development pipeline reached ₹12,800 Cr GDV with ₹3,000 Cr planned launches in FY27
Net debt at ₹5 Cr with net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.01, providing flexibility for growth
Q1FY27 pre-sales of ₹155 Cr up 9% YoY, collections at ₹164 Cr
Anand Nagar project delayed to FY29 due to wireless station shift approval timeline

exceptions: fine or penalty ₹114.63 lakh: Assistant Commissioner, Division III, Central Goods and Services Tax and Central Excise Appeals, Thane Commissionerate. (Imposition of tax Demand of Rs 1,14,62,603/- and penalty of Rs. 11,46,260/- under applicable provisions of the CGST Act,)

penalties.authority: Assistant Commissioner, Division III, Central Goods and Services Tax and Central Excise Appeals, Thane Commissionerate.
penalties.details: Imposition of tax Demand of Rs 1,14,62,603/- and penalty of Rs. 11,46,260/- under applicable provisions of the CGST Act, 2017.
penalties.impact: There is no material impact on financial & operational activities of the Company. The Company is in the process of taking necessary legal opinion and considering filing an appeal.
